ExampleDesign.DisplayName: Versal CPM6 CXL EP Bridge Design
ExampleDesign.Description: Versal CPM6 CXL EP Bridge Design — CXL Type 3 memory device on Versal Premium VP3602. Selectable CTRL0 or CTRL1 in BRIDGE mode, Gen6 x8 (CXL 3.1) or Gen5 x8 (CXL 2.0), 4 HDM Physical Agents backed by LPDDR5X DDR (channels C0, C1, C4, C5).
